title: Salomlashish, tanishish va xayrlashish
goal_uz: Dars oxirida kunning vaqtiga va vaziyatga mos salomlashasiz, o‘zingizni tanishtirasiz, suhbatdoshning ismi va qayerdanligini so‘raysiz hamda to‘g‘ri xayrlashasiz.

scenes.title: Ikkinchi darsga xush kelibsiz
scenes.say_native: Assalomu alaykum! Ikkinchi darsga xush kelibsiz. O‘tgan darsda alifboni va ismingizni harflab aytishni o‘rgandik. Bugun har qanday suhbatning boshi va oxirini o‘rganamiz: salomlashish, o‘zingizni tanishtirish va xayrlashish. Dars oxirida ingliz tilida yarim daqiqa davomida o‘zingiz haqingizda gapira olasiz.
scenes.say: Hello again! Today we will learn how to say hello, introduce ourselves and say goodbye.
scenes.say_uz: Yana salom! Bugun salomlashish, o‘zimizni tanishtirish va xayrlashishni o‘rganamiz.

scenes.title: Hello va Hi
scenes.say_native: Eng asosiy salom so‘zi — “Hello”. U neytral, ya’ni uni o‘qituvchiga ham, do‘stingizga ham, notanish odamga ham aytish mumkin. “Hi” esa qisqaroq va samimiyroq. Uni do‘stlar, sinfdoshlar va hamkasblar orasida ishlatamiz. O‘zbekchada “Assalomu alaykum” bilan “Salom” orasidagi farqga o‘xshaydi.
scenes.say: Hello, Mr Brown. Hi, Tom!
scenes.say_uz: Assalomu alaykum, janob Braun. Salom, Tom!

scenes.title: Takrorlang
scenes.say_native: Takrorlang. “Hello” so‘zida urg‘u ikkinchi bo‘g‘inda: “he-LLO”. H harfi o‘tgan darsdagidek yengil nafas bilan aytiladi, “x” emas.
scenes.say: Hello! Hi! Hello! Hi!
scenes.say_uz: Salom! Salom!

scenes.title: Kunning vaqtiga qarab
scenes.say_native: Rasmiyroq salomlashishda kunning vaqtiga qarab gapiramiz. Tushgacha “Good morning” — xayrli tong. Tushdan keyin, taxminan soat oltigacha “Good afternoon” — xayrli kun. Kechqurun esa “Good evening” — xayrli kech. Bu iboralar ishxonada, do‘konda, mehmonxonada va o‘qituvchi bilan gaplashganda juda o‘rinli.
scenes.say: Good morning! Good afternoon! Good evening!
scenes.say_uz: Xayrli tong! Xayrli kun! Xayrli kech!

scenes.title: Good night salom emas
scenes.say_native: Muhim xato: kechqurun biror joyga kirib “Good night” deyish. “Good night” salomlashish emas, u faqat xayrlashganda yoki uxlashga ketayotganda aytiladi. Kechqurun kelganingizda “Good evening” deysiz, ketayotganingizda esa “Good night”. Shuningdek, “Good day” iborasi bugungi ingliz tilida kam ishlatiladi, uning o‘rniga “Hello” yoki “Good afternoon” deng.
scenes.say: When you arrive in the evening: Good evening. When you leave or go to bed: Good night.
scenes.say_uz: Kechqurun kelganda: Good evening. Ketganda yoki uxlashga yotganda: Good night.

scenes.title: Soatga qarab salomlashing
scenes.say_native: Uchta vaziyat. Ertalab soat to‘qqizda ishxonaga keldingiz. Kunduzi soat uchda do‘konga kirdingiz. Kechqurun soat sakkizda mehmonxonaga keldingiz. Har birida nima deysiz? Baland ovozda ayting.
scenes.say: Nine a.m.? Three p.m.? Eight p.m.?
scenes.say_uz: Ertalab 9 da? Kunduzi 3 da? Kechqurun 8 da?

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar: soat to‘qqizda — “Good morning”. Soat uchda — “Good afternoon”. Soat sakkizda — “Good evening”. Agar oxirgisida “Good night” degan bo‘lsangiz, yuqoridagi qoidani yana bir bor eslang: “Good night” faqat xayrlashganda aytiladi.
scenes.say: Good morning. Good afternoon. Good evening.
scenes.say_uz: Xayrli tong. Xayrli kun. Xayrli kech.

scenes.title: How are you?
scenes.say_native: Salomdan keyin ko‘pincha “How are you?” — qalaysiz? deb so‘rashadi. Eng oddiy javob: “I’m fine, thanks. And you?” — yaxshi, rahmat, o‘zingiz-chi? Yana “I’m good” yoki “Not bad” — yomon emas, deyish mumkin. Bilib qo‘ying: bu savol ko‘pincha shunchaki odob uchun beriladi, shuning uchun javob qisqa bo‘ladi. Bu yerda muammolaringizni batafsil aytib berish odatiy emas.
scenes.say: How are you? I'm fine, thanks. And you? I'm good, thank you.
scenes.say_uz: Qalaysiz? Yaxshi, rahmat. O‘zingiz-chi? Yaxshi, rahmat.

scenes.title: Qisqa dialog
board: A: Good morning, Sarah. How are you?
B: I'm fine, thanks. And you?
scenes.say_native: Endi qisqa dialogni tinglang. Ikki hamkasb ertalab ishxonada uchrashib qoldi. Ular “Good morning” deb salomlashadi va bir-birining hol-ahvolini so‘raydi. E’tibor bering, javob juda qisqa va savol qaytariladi: “And you?”
scenes.say: Good morning, Sarah. How are you? I'm fine, thanks. And you? I'm good, thank you.
scenes.say_uz: Xayrli tong, Sara. Qalaysiz? Yaxshi, rahmat. O‘zingiz-chi? Yaxshi, rahmat.

scenes.title: Do‘stlar orasida
scenes.say_native: Do‘stlar orasida yanada erkinroq iboralar ishlatiladi. “Hey!” — juda samimiy salom. “How’s it going?” — ishlar qalay? “What’s up?” — nima gap? Bu iboralar filmlarda va ijtimoiy tarmoqlarda juda ko‘p uchraydi. Lekin ularni faqat yaqin tanishlar va tengdoshlar bilan ishlating.
scenes.say: Hey! How's it going? What's up?
scenes.say_uz: Salom! Ishlar qalay? Nima gap?

scenes.title: What's up? ga javob
board: What's up? → ✓ Not much. / Nothing much.
scenes.say_native: Ikki xato bor. Birinchisi: “What’s up?” savoliga “I’m fine” deb javob berish. To‘g‘ri javob — “Not much” yoki “Nothing much”, ya’ni “hech gap yo‘q, o‘zim”. Ikkinchisi: rahbaringiz, o‘qituvchingiz yoki notanish katta odamga “What’s up?” yoki “Hey” deyish. Bu juda erkin eshitiladi. Ularga “Hello” yoki “Good morning” deng.
scenes.say: What's up? Not much. And you?
scenes.say_uz: Nima gap? Hech gap yo‘q. O‘zingda-chi?

scenes.title: Javob bering
scenes.say_native: Uchta savolga javob bering. Har biriga mos javobni o‘ylang: rasmiyroq savolga — “I’m fine, thanks”, erkin savolga — erkinroq javob.
scenes.say: How are you? … What's up? … How's it going?
scenes.say_uz: Qalaysiz? … Nima gap? … Ishlar qalay?

scenes.title: Mumkin bo‘lgan javoblar
scenes.say_native: Mumkin bo‘lgan javoblar: “How are you?” ga — “I’m fine, thanks. And you?” “What’s up?” ga — “Not much. You?” “How’s it going?” ga — “Good, thanks!” yoki “Not bad.” Javoblaringiz shularga o‘xshash bo‘lsa, hammasi joyida.
scenes.say: I'm fine, thanks. And you? Not much. You? Good, thanks!
scenes.say_uz: Yaxshi, rahmat. O‘zingiz-chi? Hech gap yo‘q. O‘zingda-chi? Yaxshi, rahmat!

scenes.title: O‘zingizni tanishtirish
scenes.say_native: Endi o‘zingizni tanishtiramiz. Ikki asosiy usul bor. Birinchisi: “My name is Malika” — mening ismim Malika. Ikkinchisi qisqaroq: “I’m Malika” — men Malikaman. “I’m” — bu “I am” ning qisqa shakli, og‘zaki nutqda deyarli doim qisqa shakl ishlatiladi. Rasmiy vaziyatda ism va familiyani birga aytasiz: “My name is Malika Yusupova.”
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Malika. Good morning, my name is Malika Yusupova.
scenes.say_uz: Salom, men Malikaman. Xayrli tong, mening ismim Malika Yusupova.

scenes.title: Ismni so‘rash
scenes.say_native: Suhbatdoshning ismini so‘rash uchun “What’s your name?” deysiz — ismingiz nima? U o‘z ismini aytgandan keyin savolni qaytarish uchun “And you?” — sizniki-chi? degan qisqa iborani ishlatish mumkin. Ismni eshitmay qolsangiz yoki unutib qo‘ysangiz: “Sorry, what’s your name again?” — kechirasiz, ismingiz nima edi?
scenes.say: What's your name? I'm Tom. And you? I'm Aziz.
scenes.say_uz: Ismingiz nima? Men Tomman. Sizniki-chi? Men Azizman.

scenes.title: How is your name? — xato
scenes.say_native: O‘zbek o‘quvchilari ko‘p qiladigan xato: “Ismingiz qanday?” iborasini so‘zma-so‘z tarjima qilib, “How is your name?” deyish. Ingliz tilida bunday savol yo‘q. Faqat “What’s your name?” deyiladi. Xuddi shunday, “Where are you from?” savolini “From where are you?” deb aytmang.
scenes.say: Not: How is your name? Say: What's your name?
scenes.say_uz: How is your name emas. What's your name deng.

scenes.title: Ism so‘rang va ayting
scenes.say_native: Mashq. Men sizdan ismingizni so‘rayman, siz javob berasiz va savolni menga qaytarasiz. Javobni baland ovozda ayting.
scenes.say: Hello! What's your name?
scenes.say_uz: Salom! Ismingiz nima?

scenes.title: Nice to meet you
scenes.say_native: Tanishgandan keyin “Nice to meet you” deyiladi — tanishganimdan xursandman. Javob: “Nice to meet you too” — men ham. Rasmiyroq vaziyatda “Pleased to meet you” deyish mumkin. Bu ibora faqat birinchi uchrashuvda aytiladi. Tanish odamni yana ko‘rsangiz, “Nice to see you” — sizni ko‘rganimdan xursandman, deysiz.
scenes.say: Nice to meet you. Nice to meet you too. And later: Nice to see you again!
scenes.say_uz: Tanishganimdan xursandman. Men ham. Keyinroq esa: Sizni yana ko‘rganimdan xursandman!

scenes.title: Tanishuv dialogi
board: B: Hi Tom, I'm Dilshod. Nice to meet you.
A: Nice to meet you too.
scenes.say_native: Tinglang: universitetda ikki talaba birinchi marta uchrashdi. Ular salomlashadi, ismlarini aytadi va “Nice to meet you” deyishadi. Qanchalik qisqa va tabiiy ekaniga e’tibor bering.
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Tom. Hi Tom, I'm Dilshod. Nice to meet you. Nice to meet you too.
scenes.say_uz: Salom, men Tomman. Salom Tom, men Dilshodman. Tanishganimdan xursandman. Men ham.

scenes.title: Qayerliksiz?
scenes.say_native: Tanishuvdagi navbatdagi savol: “Where are you from?” — qayerliksiz? Javob “I’m from” bilan boshlanadi va keyin mamlakat yoki shahar nomi keladi: “I’m from Uzbekistan” yoki “I’m from Samarkand.” “From” — o‘zbekchadagi “-dan” qo‘shimchasiga o‘xshaydi, faqat so‘zdan oldin keladi.
scenes.say: Where are you from? I'm from Uzbekistan. I'm from Samarkand.
scenes.say_uz: Qayerliksiz? Men O‘zbekistondanman. Men Samarqanddanman.

scenes.title: Mamlakat va millat
scenes.say_native: Mamlakat nomi va millat nomi har xil so‘zlar. O‘zbekiston — “Uzbekistan”, o‘zbek — “Uzbek”. Rossiya — “Russia”, rus — “Russian”. Turkiya — “Turkey”, turk — “Turkish”. Koreya — “Korea”, koreys — “Korean”. Angliya — “England”, ingliz — “English”. Amerika — “the USA”, amerikalik — “American”. Millatni aytganda “from” ishlatilmaydi: “I’m Uzbek.”
scenes.say: I'm from Uzbekistan. I'm Uzbek. She's from Korea. She's Korean.
scenes.say_uz: Men O‘zbekistondanman. Men o‘zbekman. U Koreyadan. U koreys.

scenes.title: Mamlakat va millatni aralashtirmang
scenes.say_native: Ikki xato juda ko‘p uchraydi. “I’m from Uzbek” — xato, chunki “from” dan keyin mamlakat nomi keladi. “I’m Uzbekistan” ham xato, bu “men O‘zbekistonman” degan ma’noni beradi. To‘g‘risi: “I’m from Uzbekistan” yoki “I’m Uzbek.” Yana bir narsa: mamlakat va millat nomlari doim katta harf bilan yoziladi.
scenes.say: I'm from Uzbekistan. I'm Uzbek.
scenes.say_uz: Men O‘zbekistondanman. Men o‘zbekman.

scenes.title: O‘zingiz haqingizda
scenes.say_native: Endi siz ayting: qaysi mamlakatdan va qaysi shahardan ekaningizni, keyin millatingizni. Masalan: “I’m from Uzbekistan. I’m from Bukhara. I’m Uzbek.”
scenes.say: Where are you from?
scenes.say_uz: Qayerliksiz?

scenes.title: Mr, Mrs, Ms
scenes.say_native: Rasmiy murojaatda “Mr” — janob, “Mrs” — turmushga chiqqan ayol, “Ms” — ayol uchun neytral murojaat. Hozir ko‘p hollarda ayollarga “Ms” ishlatiladi, chunki turmush holatini bilish shart emas. Eng muhimi: bu so‘zlar familiya bilan ishlatiladi. “Mr Brown”, “Ms Smith”.
scenes.say: Good morning, Mr Brown. Hello, Ms Smith.
scenes.say_uz: Xayrli tong, janob Braun. Assalomu alaykum, Smit xonim.

scenes.title: Mr + ism emas
scenes.say_native: O‘zbekchada “Aziz aka” yoki “Malika opa” deymiz, shuning uchun ko‘pchilik “Mr Aziz” deydi. Ingliz tilida bu g‘alati eshitiladi. “Mr” va “Ms” dan keyin familiya keladi: “Mr Karimov.” Agar ismni ishlatmoqchi bo‘lsangiz, hech qanday qo‘shimchasiz, shunchaki “Aziz” deysiz. Ingliz tilida hamkasblar ko‘pincha bir-birini ism bilan chaqiradi.
scenes.say: Not Mr Aziz. Say Mr Karimov, or just Aziz.
scenes.say_uz: Mr Aziz emas. Mr Karimov yoki shunchaki Aziz deng.

scenes.title: To‘g‘ri murojaat
scenes.say_native: Uch kishiga salom bering. Birinchisi — o‘qituvchingiz Anna Smith. Ikkinchisi — rahbaringiz John Brown. Uchinchisi — sinfdoshingiz Tom. Har biriga ertalab qanday salom berasiz?
scenes.say: Your teacher, Anna Smith. Your boss, John Brown. Your classmate, Tom.
scenes.say_uz: O‘qituvchingiz Anna Smit. Rahbaringiz Jon Braun. Sinfdoshingiz Tom.

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Mumkin bo‘lgan javoblar: o‘qituvchiga — “Good morning, Ms Smith.” Rahbarga — “Good morning, Mr Brown.” Sinfdoshga — “Hi, Tom!” Do‘stlar orasida ertalab qisqartirib “Morning!” deyish ham mumkin.
scenes.say: Good morning, Ms Smith. Good morning, Mr Brown. Hi, Tom!
scenes.say_uz: Xayrli tong, Smit xonim. Xayrli tong, janob Braun. Salom, Tom!

scenes.title: Rasmiy tanishuv
board: A: Good afternoon. My name is Jasur Karimov.
B: Good afternoon, Mr Karimov. I'm Emma Brown.
scenes.say_native: Endi rasmiy vaziyat: ish uchrashuvi. Tinglang, odamlar to‘liq ism-familiyasini aytadi, “Good afternoon” va “Pleased to meet you” iboralarini ishlatadi. Bunday suhbatda qo‘l berib ko‘rishish odatiy.
scenes.say: Good afternoon. My name is Jasur Karimov. Good afternoon, Mr Karimov. I'm Emma Brown. Pleased to meet you. Pleased to meet you too.
scenes.say_uz: Xayrli kun. Mening ismim Jasur Karimov. Xayrli kun, janob Karimov. Men Emma Braunman. Tanishganimdan xursandman. Men ham.

scenes.title: Norasmiy tanishuv
board: A: Hey! I'm Lucy. What's your name?
B: Hi Lucy, I'm Nodir. Where are you from?
A: I'm from London. And you?
scenes.say_native: Endi norasmiy vaziyat: ikki yosh til kursida tanishdi. Bu yerda “Hey” va “Hi” ishlatiladi, familiya aytilmaydi, savollar qisqa. Ikkala dialogni solishtiring: so‘zlar boshqacha, lekin tuzilishi bir xil — salom, ism, qayerdanlik.
scenes.say: Hey! I'm Lucy. What's your name? Hi Lucy, I'm Nodir. Where are you from? I'm from London. And you? I'm from Tashkent.
scenes.say_uz: Salom! Men Lyusiman. Isming nima? Salom Lyusi, men Nodirman. Qayerliksan? Men Londondanman. O‘zing-chi? Men Toshkentdanman.

scenes.title: Yangi sinfdosh
board: Hi! → name → Nice to meet you → Where are you from?
scenes.say_native: Rolli o‘yin. Siz kursga keldingiz va yoningizga yangi sinfdosh o‘tirdi. U sizga salom beradi. Javob bering: ismingizni ayting, “Nice to meet you” deng va qayerlik ekanini so‘rang.
scenes.say: Hi! I'm Sophie. What's your name?
scenes.say_uz: Salom! Men Sofiman. Isming nima?

scenes.title: Boshqa odamni tanishtirish
board: This is Ms Smith, my teacher.
scenes.say_native: Ba’zan boshqa odamni tanishtirishingiz kerak bo‘ladi. Buning uchun “This is…” — bu… iborasini ishlatamiz: “This is my friend, Aziz” — bu mening do‘stim Aziz. E’tibor bering: odam haqida gapirganda ham “this is” deyiladi, “he is” emas. Rasmiy vaziyatda “Let me introduce…” — tanishtirishga ijozat bering, deyish mumkin.
scenes.say: Tom, this is my friend, Aziz. Aziz, this is Tom.
scenes.say_uz: Tom, bu mening do‘stim Aziz. Aziz, bu Tom.

scenes.title: Do‘stingizni tanishtiring
scenes.say_native: Tasavvur qiling: siz Tom va do‘stingiz bilan turibsiz. Ularni bir-biriga tanishtiring. Avval Tomga do‘stingizni, keyin do‘stingizga Tomni tanishtiring.
scenes.say: Introduce your friend to Tom.
scenes.say_uz: Do‘stingizni Tomga tanishtiring.

scenes.title: Xayrlashish
board: Have a nice day! · Take care!
scenes.say_native: Endi xayrlashamiz. “Goodbye” — neytral xayr. “Bye” yoki “Bye-bye” — samimiy, do‘stlar orasida. Ko‘pincha keyingi uchrashuvni ham aytamiz: “See you later” — keyinroq ko‘rishamiz, “See you tomorrow” — ertaga ko‘rishamiz, “See you soon” — tez orada ko‘rishamiz. Yana iliq iboralar: “Have a nice day!” — kuningiz yaxshi o‘tsin, “Take care!” — o‘zingizni ehtiyot qiling.
scenes.say: Goodbye! Bye! See you tomorrow. Have a nice day! Take care!
scenes.say_uz: Xayr! Xayr! Ertaga ko‘rishamiz. Kuningiz yaxshi o‘tsin! O‘zingizni ehtiyot qiling!

scenes.title: Kechqurun xayrlashish
board: ✓ Good night! / Have a nice evening!
scenes.say_native: Avval aytganimizning teskarisi ham xato. “Good evening” bilan xayrlashilmaydi, bu faqat salomlashish. Kechqurun ketayotganingizda “Good night!” yoki “Have a nice evening!” — kechingiz yaxshi o‘tsin, deysiz.
scenes.say: Arriving: Good evening. Leaving: Good night, or have a nice evening!
scenes.say_uz: Kelganda: Good evening. Ketganda: Good night yoki Have a nice evening!

scenes.title: Qanday xayrlashasiz?
scenes.say_native: Uchta vaziyat. Birinchi: darsdan keyin sinfdoshingiz bilan xayrlashyapsiz, ertaga yana ko‘rishasiz. Ikkinchi: kechqurun mehmonxona xodimi bilan xayrlashib, xonangizga ketyapsiz. Uchinchi: kunduzi do‘kondan chiqyapsiz. Har birida nima deysiz?
scenes.say: What do you say?
scenes.say_uz: Nima deysiz?

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 3) Thank you. Have a nice day!
scenes.say_native: Mumkin bo‘lgan javoblar: sinfdoshga — “Bye! See you tomorrow!” Kechqurun mehmonxonada — “Good night!” Do‘kondan chiqayotganda — “Thank you. Have a nice day!” Sotuvchi ham ko‘pincha “You too!” — sizga ham, deb javob beradi.
scenes.say: Bye! See you tomorrow! Good night! Thank you, have a nice day! You too!
scenes.say_uz: Xayr! Ertaga ko‘rishamiz! Xayrli tun! Rahmat, kuningiz yaxshi o‘tsin! Sizga ham!

scenes.title: Tabiiy talaffuz: so‘zlarni ulash
board: Nice to meet you → [nays tə mi:-chu]
scenes.say_native: Inglizlar tez gapirganda so‘zlarni bir-biriga ulab aytadi. “How are you?” iborasida “how” va “are” orasida yengil “w” tovushi paydo bo‘ladi: “hau-wa-yu”. “Nice to meet you” da esa “meet” ning oxiridagi “t” va “you” qo‘shilib, “ch” ga o‘xshab eshitiladi: “mi-chu”. Avval sekin, aniq gapiring, lekin bunday ulanishni eshitib tushunishingiz kerak.
scenes.say: How are you? Nice to meet you. Slowly: How. Are. You. Fast: How are you?
scenes.say_uz: Qalaysiz? Tanishganimdan xursandman. Sekin va tez.

scenes.title: Tez aytib ko‘ring
scenes.say_native: Uchta iborani avval sekin, keyin tabiiy tezlikda takrorlang. So‘zlar orasida to‘xtamang, ularni bitta oqim qilib ayting.
scenes.say: How are you? Nice to meet you. Where are you from?
scenes.say_uz: Qalaysiz? Tanishganimdan xursandman. Qayerliksiz?

scenes.title: Savol ohangi
scenes.say_native: Ohang haqida bir qoida. “What”, “where”, “how” kabi so‘roq so‘z bilan boshlanadigan savollarda ovoz odatda oxirida pasayadi: “Where are you from?” “Ha” yoki “yo‘q” deb javob beriladigan savollarda esa ovoz oxirida ko‘tariladi: “Are you from Tashkent?” Bu haqda keyingi darslarda batafsil gaplashamiz.
scenes.say: Where are you from? Are you from Tashkent?
scenes.say_uz: Qayerliksiz? Siz Toshkentdanmisiz?

scenes.title: Tinglang: aeroportda
scenes.say_native: Endi uzunroq dialogni tinglang. Aeroportda ikki yo‘lovchi tanishib qoldi. Tinglab bo‘lgach, uchta savolga javob berasiz: ayolning ismi nima, u qaysi mamlakatdan va qaysi shahardan?
scenes.say: Hi! Is this seat free? Yes, it is. Thanks. I'm Ji-woo, by the way. Nice to meet you, Ji-woo. I'm Akmal. Where are you from? I'm from Korea, from Busan. And you? I'm from Uzbekistan, from Bukhara. Oh, nice!
scenes.say_uz: Salom! Bu joy bo‘shmi? Ha, bo‘sh. Rahmat. Aytgancha, men Ji-vu. Tanishganimdan xursandman, Ji-vu. Men Akmalman. Qayerliksiz? Men Koreyadanman, Pusandan. O‘zingiz-chi? Men O‘zbekistondanman, Buxorodan. Oh, zo‘r!

scenes.title: Savollarga javob bering
scenes.say_native: Savollar: ayolning ismi nima? U qaysi mamlakatdan? Qaysi shahardan? Javoblarni daftaringizga yozing yoki baland ovozda ayting.
scenes.say: What's her name? Where is she from? What city is she from?
scenes.say_uz: Uning ismi nima? U qayerdan? Qaysi shahardan?

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar: uning ismi Ji-woo. U Koreyadan, Pusan shahridan. Akmal esa O‘zbekistondan, Buxorodan. E’tibor bering: “by the way” — aytgancha, degan ibora ham chiqdi. U suhbat davomida o‘zini tanishtirish uchun juda qulay.
scenes.say: Her name is Ji-woo. She's from Korea, from Busan.
scenes.say_uz: Uning ismi Ji-vu. U Koreyadan, Pusandan.

scenes.title: 30 soniyalik tanishtiruv
scenes.say_native: Eng muhim mashq. Ekrandagi rejaga qarab, o‘zingizni yarim daqiqa davomida tanishtiring: salomlashing, ismingiz va familiyangizni ayting, qayerlik ekaningizni va millatingizni ayting, “Nice to meet you” deng va xayrlashing. Video to‘xtaganda baland ovozda gapiring.
scenes.say: Now introduce yourself. You have thirty seconds. Start!
scenes.say_uz: Endi o‘zingizni tanishtiring. 30 soniyangiz bor. Boshlang!

scenes.title: Bugun nimani o‘rgandik
board: Hello / Hi · Good morning / afternoon / evening
What's your name? · Where are you from?
Nice to meet you · Goodbye · See you · Good night
scenes.say_native: Xulosa. Neytral “Hello” va samimiy “Hi” ni, kunning vaqtiga qarab salomlashishni o‘rgandik. “Good night” faqat xayrlashganda aytilishini bildik. Hol-ahvol so‘rashni, o‘zimizni tanishtirishni, ism va qayerdanlikni so‘rashni, mamlakat va millat nomlarini o‘rgandik. “Mr” va “Ms” familiya bilan ishlatiladi. Va nihoyat, vaziyatga mos xayrlashishni o‘rgandik.
scenes.say: Great work! Now you can say hello, introduce yourself and say goodbye.
scenes.say_uz: Zo‘r ish! Endi salomlasha, o‘zingizni tanishtira va xayrlasha olasiz.

scenes.title: Uyga vazifa
board: Record 30 seconds: greeting → name → country → goodbye
scenes.say_native: Uyga vazifa. Birinchi: telefoningizga o‘zingizni tanishtirgan 30 soniyalik ovoz yozing: salom, ism-familiya, qayerdanlik, millat, “Nice to meet you” va xayrlashuv. Ikkinchi: ikki kishi birinchi marta tanishadigan olti qatorli dialog yozing. Tekshiring: “Good night” salom o‘rnida ishlatilmagan, “How is your name” yo‘q, “Mr” dan keyin familiya turibdi. Keyingi darsda sonlarni o‘rganamiz. Ko‘rishguncha!
scenes.say: See you next time. Bye!
scenes.say_uz: Keyingi darsda ko‘rishamiz. Xayr!

homework_uz: 1) O‘zingizni tanishtirgan 30 soniyalik ovoz yozing: salom, ism-familiya, mamlakat va shahar, millat, Nice to meet you, xayrlashuv. 2) Ikki kishining birinchi tanishuvi haqida 6 qatorli dialog yozing. Mezon: kunning vaqtiga mos salom, What's your name? (How is your name emas), Mr/Ms + familiya, to‘g‘ri xayrlashuv.

quiz.q: It's 3 p.m. You enter a shop. What do you say?
quiz.why_uz: Tushdan keyin, taxminan soat 18 gacha — Good afternoon.

options: When we arrive in the evening
When we leave at night or go to bed
When we meet someone for the first time
quiz.why_uz: Good night — salom emas, faqat xayrlashganda yoki uxlashdan oldin aytiladi.
Ismni so‘rash: What's your name? “How is your name?” — o‘zbekchadan so‘zma-so‘z tarjima, xato.

quiz.q: A friend asks: “What's up?” The best answer is:
quiz.why_uz: What's up? ga odatda Not much / Nothing much deb javob beriladi.
From dan keyin mamlakat nomi keladi: I'm from Uzbekistan. Millat: I'm Uzbek.

quiz.q: Your teacher is Anna Smith. How do you greet her politely?
quiz.why_uz: Rasmiy murojaatda Ms + familiya: Ms Smith.

quiz.q: Someone says “Nice to meet you.” You answer:
quiz.why_uz: Javob: Nice to meet you too.

quiz.q: How do you introduce your friend?
options: He is my friend Aziz, meet.
quiz.why_uz: Boshqa odamni tanishtirishda This is… ishlatiladi.

quiz.q: You leave a shop in the afternoon. What can you say?
options: Thank you. Have a nice day!
quiz.why_uz: Do‘kondan chiqayotganda: Thank you. Have a nice day! Good evening bilan xayrlashilmaydi.
